wants.topic: Macro-Scale 'Complete History of India' (9000 BC to Modern Era)
wants.evidence: 'The Unseen Bharat' (vsNormal 71.77, 546k views) and 'kwy true tale' (vsNormal 5.16, 3.7M views) achieved their highest reach with all-encompassing Indian timeline documentaries.

wants.topic: Suppressed/Hidden Lineage & Clan Sagas (e.g., Agnivansh, Forgotten Warrior Orders)
wants.evidence: 'Kahani Ka Safar' hit a massive 92.71 vsNormal (1.2M views in 9 days) on their Agnivansh video, outperforming all narrative content on their channel.
'Story Plug Studio' scored 21.46 vsNormal (1.7M views in 33 days) focusing specifically on the 1877 Madras Famine ('82 Lakh Maut Ka Sach').

wants.topic: Destruction & Secret Architecture of Iconic Monuments/Institutions
wants.evidence: 'kwy true tale' (Nalanda University creation to destruction, vsNormal 3.98) and 'The Unseen Bharat' (Red Fort hidden world, vsNormal 54.69).

gaps: Rigorous, source-backed histories of ancient Indian royal lineages (Agnivansh, Nagavansh) separating myth from verified historical chronicles.
Granular historical breakdowns of colonial tragedies and famines beyond basic high-school freedom struggle narratives.
Detailed military tactic breakdowns of forgotten Indian battle victories against foreign invasions.
saturated: Standalone, generic Indus Valley Civilization overviews ('kwy true tale' failed at 0.03 vsNormal).
Generic temple history overviews like Kedarnath without a unique mystery or mega-scale hook ('The Unseen Bharat' dropped to 0.15 vsNormal).
Abstract global history/civilizations like Maya or early hominids without direct connection to Indian history ('History Industry' Maya video tanked at 0.06 vsNormal).
Dry statutory/legal histories of India ('50 Laws History' performed at 0.02 vsNormal).
